items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And so we did and when Hamp came in town we were recording this music.

ctx.x: Well, he used to play with Benny Goodman. I'll go back and give you a little story. One day when Hamp came -- see Hamp, before he organized his band he wanted me to be the musical director for his band, and we were negotiating. So when Benny Goodman came to Chicago to play at the Chicago Theatre Hamp had a record date set up. So he had wired me ahead and asked me to make some arrangements with a record date, and Spencer Odom and myself wrote some arrangements for --
